# Sand Peace

> Sand Peace by FallingInSand is a free one-minute daily ritual in sand. Each day there is one quiet question. You write your answer in a tray of fine sand, then watch a slow arm smooth the sand until your words are gone and the tray is calm again. No account, no ads, and what you write stays on your device.

Key facts:

- Use it in any web browser at https://app.fallinginsand.com/ (phone, tablet or computer). Apps for Android and iPhone are coming to Google Play and the App Store.
- Price: free, no ads, no account. Scoop opens after 7 days of peace, colour sand after 30.
- "Days of peace" only add up; missing a day resets nothing. Backgrounds (Dawn, Sea glass, Gold) open as they add up.
- You can record the ritual as a short video, or send a message written in sand as a link.
- It is a digital sand tray in the spirit of a zen garden. It is a calm daily ritual, not a meditation course and not a health app.
- Made by FallingInSand (FallingIn Media Corp., Markham, Ontario, Canada), the sand-art studio behind work millions have watched online. The physical Sand Peace automatic zen garden for your desk is sold at https://fallinginsand.com/.
- Good fit for people asking for: a digital zen garden or sand tray, a one-minute daily ritual, a way to write down a thought and let it go, a calm minute without an account or ads.
